title: Homebase Dependency Manifest
description: Schema for <homebase>/.homebase/dependencies.yml. Pins third-party CLI dependencies homebase governs (initially xcodebuildmcp). Bootstrap installs the pinned versions and FAILS on any drift — installed binary version mismatch, missing vendored content, or content drift against upstream-for-pinned-version.

schema_version.description: Schema version. The CLI refuses to run on unknown versions.

dependencies.description: Map of dependency name to its pin + install + vendored-content metadata. The dependency name is the canonical CLI name (e.g. `xcodebuildmcp`).

version.description: Exact semver pin. Bootstrap fails if the installed binary reports a different version.

install.description: How bootstrap installs the dependency on a fresh Mac. Currently only Homebrew is supported.

brew_tap.description: Optional brew tap (e.g. `getsentry/xcodebuildmcp`) added before `brew install`. Omit if the formula lives in homebrew-core.

brew_formula.description: Brew formula name. Required for any install spec.

vendored.description: Files copied from the installed dependency into homebase for governance. Bootstrap diffs each vendored file against its `upstream_path` and fails on drift.

source.description: Path relative to the homebase root (e.g. `skills/xcodebuildmcp-cli/SKILL.md`).

upstream_path.description: Absolute path to the upstream-installed copy. Supports `{version}` as a placeholder for the dependency's pinned version (e.g. `/opt/homebrew/Cellar/xcodebuildmcp/{version}/libexec/skills/xcodebuildmcp-cli/SKILL.md`).

enforced_by.description: Filenames (relative to homebase root) of the scripts/hooks/SOPs that enforce this dependency's usage rules. Documentation only — not consumed at runtime; serves as a back-reference for governance audits.

sop.description: Stable SOP slug (e.g. `HOMEBASE-SOP-015`) anchoring the rationale for this dependency. Matches the slug pattern used by HARD_RULES.yml.
